title: High fan-in symbol: content.usDate (13 dependents)
description: "content.usDate" is depended upon by 13 other symbols — well above the repo average. High fan-in concentrates change risk: edits here ripple across many call sites, and it often indicates a missing or overly broad abstraction.
suggested_actions: Split the symbol along distinct responsibilities its callers use
Introduce narrower interfaces so callers depend only on what they need
Stabilize its public contract to limit churn for dependents
